subject: End-of-quarter pipeline spring clean
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: End-of-quarter pipeline spring clean

Team —

Q4 is 6 weeks out and finance asked for a short, actionable sweep of SFDC records so our forecast is not overstated going into the close. Please follow the checklist below and push updates by EOD Friday, Sep 24: 

- Run the "EoQ: Probable/Uncommitted" report and sort by Close Date.
- If Close Date is >90 days from today and there's been no activity in 30+ days, mark as Closed-Lost or move to "Nurture" (don’t leave it in Commit).
- Reconfirm Stage & Probability on any deals > $25k; flag deals > $100k for a quick finance review (cc'd).
- Remove duplicate/placeholder opportunities and merge notes into the primary opp.
- Update next steps and the single point-of-contact in SFDC; if you need help, add a comment on the shared sheet.

Attached is a small CSV template to help triage (EoQ_pipeline_tidy_template.csv) and I’ve dropped a short filter/link in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3EoQ-pipeline-cleanup

Why this matters: our last forecast had ~3 deals aged >120 days in Commit that moved to Closed-Lost; we need to avoid that bleed this quarter.

If anything is >$100k or has legal/technical blockers, loop in Hannah and I immediately. Thanks — brief sweep only, not a full due diligence.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: EoQ_pipeline_tidy_template.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter pipeline spring clean

Got it — quick clarification: for deals in Proposal stage with close dates inside 30 days but <$25k and no activity in the last 21 days, should we close them as Lost or move to Nurture? I can run the filter tonight and start tagging, just want to follow the right rule.

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter pipeline spring clean

Thanks Marcus — good question. Use this rule of thumb:

- <$25k and no activity in 21+ days: move to Nurture unless there's a confirmed verbal close scheduled.
- $25k–$100k: confirm next-step within 7 days; if no response, stage to Negotiation or Nurture depending on signal.
- >$100k: do NOT move or close without a quick finance check — flag those to me and Hannah (include SFDC ID and latest contact).

I also exported a quick list of opps that haven't seen activity in 30+ days and put it in Drive (stale-opps-list.csv). If you can take the top 25 by ARR and run through today/tomorrow, that will cover most of the risk.

Salesforce quick filter: https://salesforce.example.com/00O5g000005XYZQ?filter=EoQ

Thanks — brief heads-down effort here. Ping me if you need me to run an assist on any account.

Vivek

Attachment: stale-opps-list.csv (CSV, 34KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: End-of-quarter pipeline spring clean — quick status

Done on my side — short update: 

- Ran the stale-opps export, reviewed 42 records.
- Closed 9 as Closed-Lost (notes added with reason: no-response / duplicate / budget).
- Moved 11 to Nurture and updated next steps.
- Revalidated stage & probability for 7 deals > $25k.

Deals to note (moved/closed):
- RDW-2026-BW-347 — moved to Nurture (contact needs product workshop)
- RDW-2026-BW-312 — Closed-Lost (duplicate opportunity)
- RDW-2026-BW-330 — Closed-Lost (budget slipped)

Attached snapshot: updated-opps-snapshot.csv. I’ll keep iterating on the remaining list tomorrow; Marcus, flag anything you want me to take offline.

Laura

Redwood Inference
